Hello! Look at this example. My friends and I have a plan. I say: "We are going to watch a film on Friday." I use are, then going to, then the plain verb.
Rule: use am, is or are, then going to, then a verb, to talk about a plan.

Now you try. Correct: "I going to study tonight."
